document:0:238:0.text:
Crush and press the <style="highlight">phantoleaf</style> to extract its juice. Then, dissect the <style="highlight">swamp frog</style> and remove its venom sac from the abdomen to harvest the paralytic toxin. Finally, pour in the phantoleaf juice and shake the mixture thoroughly.
Don't shake it too vigorously. If white foam forms, you will need to start over.
document:0:238:0.source_cn:
将<style="highlight">灵织草</style>捣碎压汁，再解剖<style="highlight">诡沼蛙</style>腹部取出毒囊，提炼其中的麻痹素，倒入草药汁摇晃混合。
切忌用力摇晃，如浮出白沫需重新炼制。
